sources.notes: Pinned licence text distinguishes legal requirements from author wishes; README contains stale custom-licence wording. No engine code was added to this app. Ektachrome 100 info explicitly says still; motion 100D was excluded.

sources.name: Fotufilm
sources.license: 47 runtime stock profiles CC-BY-SA-4.0; project-authored engine Apache-2.0
sources.notes: Profile ID acros100 explicitly names Acros 100 II. All models still need a fixed, nonspatial bake. A prior isolated Phoenix bake recipe is in research/luts-2026-10-24/community/fotufilm/PhoenixLUTBaker.swift.

sources.name: Bicyclelad Phoenix first generation
sources.notes: Prior download confirmed flat/punchy 64-cube assets. Current page still advertises LUT ZIP; direct urllib fetch got HTTP 403 in this audit. Not Phoenix II.

sources.name: ANDP FilmStyles
sources.license: standard purchase excludes software/application embedding; separate written integration licence required
sources.notes: Product listings checked for CUBE availability. No purchases. Polaroid 600 vintage-versus-current, Kodachrome 1935-62 ISO mismatch uncertainty, and Konica Centuria APS-versus-35mm excluded from strict matches.

sources.name: PictureFX
sources.license: general policy CC-BY-NC-4.0 unless file-specific exception; app redistribution unresolved
sources.notes: CineStill 800T ready LUT listing supplements the Fotufilm model. SX-70 Core is related only, not counted as matching current Color SX-70 chemistry.

filters accessible only within other apps without a verified downloadable asset
